observations.behavior: Adds a new workflow and its supporting activity, plus tests, to handle post-import steps after V3 warehouse loading.
observations.posthog_connection: This workflow executes metadata and quality checks (signals, enrichment, statistics, size, DuckLake copy) after the warehouse load completes, preventing those steps from missing when the load consumer is separate.
